title: Oil Keeps Pushing, Yields Signal Recession, Tech Near Correction...Here Are The Trades
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: Without an oil pullback, no reason to buy into the weekend; oil higher for longer is wearing down the consumer.
Yields falling on recession fears, not lower inflation, which is negative for stocks; recession likely by early 2027 if oil stays ~95.
Institutions likely accumulating beaten-down AI names; one more flush would create buying opportunities.

calls.condition: Unless oil pulls back, likely another down day; a break of the daily trend line could extend to the trend line from the 2021 bull-market high.
calls.reason: Futures below yesterday's low as oil rises; must recover above the daily trend line.
calls.quote: it does set up unless we get oil to pull back to a potential another down day on Wall Street.

calls.reason: Nasdaq holding its pivot low while S&P broke, showing relative strength and likely institutional accumulation for an AI bounce.
calls.quote: there may be a little bit of a technical institutional buy program going on here, accumulating some of these beaten-down names.

calls.reason: Oil keeps pushing on escalation rhetoric; descending trend line from ~120 March top gives resistance ~104.
calls.quote: if we do move up, there is going to be resistance around 104 on spot crude here.

calls.condition: Strong buyer if it dumps into the gap fill / 0.886 Fibonacci level today or early next week.
calls.reason: Earnings dip recovered; pre-set swing level at pivot, gap fill and 0.886 fib.
calls.quote: If we dump today into that level or early next week, I am a strong buyer of WDC at that level.

calls.condition: Likely buys a swing long at the approaching gap fill (~315 level mentioned ambiguously).
calls.reason: High-quality AI chip maker approaching a major gap fill.
calls.quote: We get down there, I likely will be picking this up as a swing trade long.

calls.condition: Negative while below the ascending trend line until the ~3940 double bottom is tagged.
calls.reason: Dipped below 4,000 then recovered; still below broken ascending trend line.
calls.quote: as long as we stay below this ascending trend line, I've got to be at least negative until we tag these lows at double bottom around 3940.

calls.condition: Small swing long via SLV, take profit on a ~5% bounce; long-term buying only at 50 or below.
calls.reason: Hit trend line support off pivot highs; still expects 50 or below before long-term loading.
calls.quote: I still think unfortunately, we're probably going down to 50 or below on silver

calls.reason: Long and underwater; oversold and will add at the next pivot low.
calls.quote: I am in this on the long side down on this position. My next add will be right at this pivot low.

calls.condition: If it breaks and closes below the 81,000 line, next downside target 75,500.
calls.reason: Repeatedly holding 81,000; sitting on the sidelines waiting for direction.
calls.quote: If it breaks here and closes below this line, again, 75.5 is my next downside target.
